newsitem.title: FRANCE: Temporary stop to flown airfreight at Rennes airport.
newsitem.headline: Temporary stop to flown airfreight at Rennes airport.

text.p: Rennes airport said it will suspend flown airfreight operations between August 4 and 10 due to renovation work on its main runway.

"While trucked airfreight activities will continue as normal, there will be no bellyhold freight transported on scheduled passenger services operating from Rennes but which are being transferred to Dinard, including Air France Europe and Brit Air," an airport authority cargo official told Reuters.

He added:"Two of the major flown airfreight operators at Rennes, Jet Services and United Parcel Service (UPS), have decided to transfer their air cargo services to Nantes while the airport is closed."

Postal freight, normally flown between Paris and Rennes aboard L'Aeropostale's freighter fleet, is expected to be moved by road," the official said. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
